capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern pyusd-paypal, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

review.evidence: W2R46 reviewed exact VaultV2 source/runtime, constructor-to-block 26115203 event history, native share issuance, roles, current adapters, RegistryList and every current subregistry/factory. Block hash 0x1b8e8fe59dc6658999fa93a3f1e1a854885dfb8d7eaacf9a8b1c4a10a1d9bee6; timestamp 2026-10-03T23:48:35Z. All 2488 vault logs were retrieved to terminal pagination. Minted raw shares 84317410746034723248273132 equal deposit shares plus accrued performance/management fee shares transaction-by-transaction, with zero unexplained issuance; burns 58977930073590603179032343 leave 25339480672444120069240789, equal pinned totalSupply. Complete owner/curator/allocator/sentinel histories and current mappings retain the authored controls; former allocator 0x13de0cee0b83562cbfd46682e10ffa4e3c5090e1 is disabled. RegistryList owner is Morpho Safe 0xcba28b38103307ec8da98377fff9816c164f9afa, 6-of-10, no enabled modules, zero guard/fallback handler. Owner and curator Safes remain 1-of-1 with no modules and zero guard/fallback handler. All four subregistries bind immutable factory identities; all five factories only authorize their own constructed adapters/vaults. Crucially, RegistryList owner may append arbitrary registries, and curator may replace or zero adapterRegistry with zero selector delay. The registry is not an immutable allocation protection: arbitrary future adapters remain reachable through curator authorization and the 259200-second addAdapter delay. This is resolved adverse allocation/accounting reach, not absence of latent powers or a complete execution-scope certificate. Native user minting still transfers PYUSD before issuing shares, and fee issuance remains subject to immutable fee/rate bounds. Exact-vault incident search covered issuer risk/security/research notices, Morpho security/audit archives, scoped independent exploit reporting, and complete issuance/ownership history from creation on 2026-07-31 through the pin. No relevant local mint/control incident found; Huma/Resolv or parent-issuer incidents are not this wrapper's history. Organizational signer identity and independently attested key custody remain separate scoped non-disclosures. Financial reconciliation and parent supervision are not asserted.
